bug_semantics: CredentialsPermissionChecker authorizes only credential IDs whose credential-type keys appear in a set inferred statically from unresolved node parameters. An authenticated member with edit access to a shared workflow can place another user's known credential ID on an HTTP Request node and make genericAuthType or nodeCredentialType an expression. The pre-execution checker sees the expression text rather than its runtime-resolved credential type, omits the credential ID from the ownership query, and execution later resolves and loads the unauthorized credential, allowing use or exfiltration.
flaw_origin: The smallest causal source change is PR #25599 member 7d6023fe3478df86d88f3602f1ea5b53819a050b. It changed mapCredIdsToNodes from checking every referenced credential to skipping credential keys absent from getActiveCredentialTypes, whose static inference did not fail closed for expressions. Public squash 608e3bf214328e679c03da3e4a6e9c22ceaac9ca carried the flaw but is not the smallest BIC. Later bundle 2d9a2ec76e180b54e8091e31b1e0638c909abd99 added the unresolved genericAuthType value to the set, fixing literal generic types but preserving the advisory's expression mismatch and therefore not originating the flaw.
ai_marker: absent: the complete BIC commit object 7d6023fe3478df86d88f3602f1ea5b53819a050b names human author and committer Guillaume Jacquart <jacquart.guillaume@gmail.com> and contains only the message 'refine credential access check to discard not actively used credentials', with no AI, bot, generation, or co-author marker.
evidence: The assigned primary and reviewer agree on release landing fix_sha f69dfc6dd2178a14ea1624d2e1d403c2e755042f but disagree on direct_fix_sha: the primary claims mainline bundle 2222fe3a6c886a9059f28e1b6d4bdb10ee420624, while the reviewer claims the 2.32.x backport bundle f69dfc6dd2178a14ea1624d2e1d403c2e755042f. Re-run object checks show that both direct-fix claims are wrong. `git show --stat` identifies f69dfc6dd2178a14ea1624d2e1d403c2e755042f as `chore: Bundle/2.x (backport to release-candidate/2.32.x) (#34692)` changing 79 files and 2222fe3a6c886a9059f28e1b6d4bdb10ee420624 as `chore: Bundle/2.x (#34680)` changing 77 files, so neither is a smallest direct patch. The public PR #34680 body says it was cherry-picked from inaccessible n8n-private PR #279. `GET /repos/n8n-io/n8n/pulls/34680/commits` returns only aggregate import 97f5ba3f824019665adb81a9976174e5f778d71d and test-helper follow-up f65845e5fb0cb6a59c3385095b9ed2bee2e738ed; the aggregate message lists `fix(core): Improve credential type matching in pre-execution checks (#215)` among unrelated changes, and `GET /repos/n8n-io/n8n-private/pulls/279` returns 404, so no public full SHA for the underlying direct fix can be verified. The release landing remains verified: `git diff db5e2d068bc92a28a455598daa578fe405dce4bc f69dfc6dd2178a14ea1624d2e1d403c2e755042f -- packages/cli/src/executions/pre-execution-checks/credentials-permission-checker.ts` adds the isExpression import and returns null for expression-valued nodeCredentialType and genericAuthType, forcing mapCredIdsToNodes to authorize every referenced credential. `git tag --contains f69dfc6dd2178a14ea1624d2e1d403c2e755042f --list 'n8n@2.32.*' --sort=version:refname` begins at n8n@2.32.1, and `git grep` finds both expression guards in n8n@2.32.1 but none in n8n@2.32.0, matching the first-party advisory's patched boundary 2.32.1 (alongside 1.123.67 and 2.31.5). For origin and parent, the API commit object for 7d6023fe3478df86d88f3602f1ea5b53819a050b gives sole parent 0970e4f32cb7efbe257f0ea8105233c3b3a4e179 and the human, trailer-free message; its production patch adds activeCredTypes filtering. Direct parent-tree `git grep -n -E 'Object\.values\(node\.credentials\)|activeCredTypes|getActiveCredentialTypes' 0970e4f32cb7efbe257f0ea8105233c3b3a4e179 -- .../credentials-permission-checker.ts` finds only the unconditional Object.values mapping and no active-type helper/filter, directly proving parent absence.
reasoning: The vulnerability begins when 7d6023fe3478df86d88f3602f1ea5b53819a050b replaces the conservative invariant of checking every referenced credential with a static active-type filter. Expression parameters resolve later, so a credential may be runtime-active while omitted statically; the immediate parent cannot take this path because it maps every credential ID. PR #25599 is publicly decomposable and its first member contains the production mechanism, so neither its squash nor the later genericAuthType bundle is the BIC. The fix disagreement cannot be resolved by choosing one aggregate: f69dfc6dd2178a14ea1624d2e1d403c2e755042f is the verified 2.32.1 release landing and is therefore retained as fix_sha, but both proposed direct_fix_sha values are bundle commits and are rejected. Because the underlying source fix was imported from a private repository and its commit object is unavailable, direct_fix_sha is justified null rather than falsely naming an aggregate or import. The public landing diff and adjacent tag boundary nevertheless verify the fix completely for the selected release line. AI attribution depends only on the smallest BIC commit object, which has a human identity and no AI marker; AI markers on later bundles, imports, or fixes are irrelevant. The gate-complete verdict is therefore NOT_AI.
remaining_gap: The full SHA and commit object of the smallest direct source fix in private PR #215/#279 are not publicly accessible; only the public aggregate import, squash landing, and release backports can be verified. This does not affect the verified BIC, BIC-only AI attribution, public fix behavior, or patched version boundary.
